prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose Your Desktop Companion Archetype", "Select a companion archetype below to inspect its personality traits and desktop behaviors."]
1: ["Configure Pet Companion Temperament", "Adjust your companion's activity levels and vocal interactions before building visual assets.", "Companion Temperament"]
2: ["Preparing Your Pet's Workspace", "Watch your companion test desktop movement while asset compilation finishes."]
3: ["Master Your Desktop Companion Controls", "Review these essential shortcuts to summon, hide, or chat with your desktop companion anytime.", "Essential Desktop Shortcuts"]
4: ["Welcome to Your Interactive Desktop Companion"]
5: ["Sign In to Access Your Companion Vault", "Signing in automatically syncs and restores all previously adopted desktop companions."]
6: ["Ensure single-subject lighting and clear framing for optimal 3D pet asset rendering.", "Photo Asset Quality Requirements"]
7: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Assign an official name to finalize your companion registration.", "Companion Name", "Registered Companion"]
8: []
9: ["If your companion moves off-screen, right-click the system tray icon to recall or reposition it.", "Launch Desktop Companion"]
